provenance.algorithm: Forward fixed-point expansion over reaction hyperedges: an operation fires only when every metabolite on its input side is reachable. Products inherit a first-production reaction certificate.
provenance.denominator: Every unique ChEBI entity appearing as a has_reactant object in at least one catalog reaction.
provenance.compartmentPolicy: Compartment-blind because model compartment assignments and exchange reactions are not curated.
provenance.stoichiometryPolicy: Stoichiometric coefficients are retained in the source graph but reachability tests presence, not flux or quantity.
provenance.caveat: Reachability is a topological pathway-completeness metric, not evidence of growth, thermodynamic feasibility, enzyme activity, or flux.

medium.label: Glucose-based plant defined-medium proxy
medium.interpretation: A computational plant proxy containing carbon, inorganic nitrogen, phosphate, sulfate, common ions, trace molybdate, water, gases, and pH currency. It is not a Cannabis tissue culture recipe and does not imply that all seeded species are extracellular exchange metabolites.
